sector.narrative: Breastfeeding protection, promotion and support, including work on the Code of Marketing of Breastmilk Substitutes
Care and support for HIV affected women, children and adolescents including ECD, child protection, mental health and psychosocial support, and social protection services
Child health policy advocacy, evidence generation, national / subnational capacity development
Climate-resilient and environmentally sustainable health care facilities
Community engagement, feedback and accountability mechanisms
Diet diversity in early childhood, including complementary feeding, multiple micronutrient powders and lipid-based nutrition supplements
Early detection and treatment for children with life-threatening wasting
Ending violence against women and girls
Evidence generation and policy advocacy for immunization
Facility based maternal and newborn care (including emergency obstetric and newborn care, quality improvement)
Guideline development and Technical Support for HIV prevention, treatment and care
HIV testing and counselling including EID, POC EID, PITC, ANC testing, Self testing, Retesting and Family based testing
HSS - Health systems procurement and supplies management
IMNCI facilities and referral level management of childhood illnesses (e.g. ETAT, inpatient care)
Immunization supply chain, including cold chain
Implementation of community based integrated prevention and management of childhood illnesses (e.g. iCCM)
Legal identity (including birth registration/civil registration and vital statistics systems)
Maternal and newborn care policy advocacy, evidence generation, national / subnational capacity development
Maternal nutrition, including counselling, micronutrient supplementation and dietary support
Micronutrient supplementation in early childhood, including vitamin A supplementation and deworming prophylaxis
National multisectoral strategies and plans to prevent stunting and wasting (excludes intervention specific strategies)
Preparedness and response for maternal and child nutrition
Prevention of undernutrition and micronutrient deficiencies in middle childhood and adolescence

Programme support for PMTCT including for triple elimination, viral load monitoring, retention in care, infant feeding, PreP among HIV-negative women and negative partners, family planning and partner testing
Response and support services for girls, boys, and women experiencing violence, exploitaiton, abuse and neglect
Salt iodization and other large-scale food fortification
Strengthening data and national information systems in emergencies, including rapid assessments, IPC, smart surveys and other nutrition surveys
Strengthening data and national information systems, including routine systems, nutrition surveys and assessments (early childhood nutrition)
Technical assistance - Early detection and treatment of malnutrition
Technical assistance - Immunization (excluding Polio technical assistance)
Technical assistance - Nutrition in early childhood
Treatment for PMTCT and infant ARV prophylaxis
WASH in Health Care Facilities – service delivery
Water sector policy and administrative management
